summary: Tested 2 new Specifier Tools: Viewing Distance Calculator (/viewing-distance) and Power Consumption Estimator (/power-estimator). Both are fully functional client-side calculator tools with React state management and useMemo for computations. All UI elements, interactive features, and calculations working correctly.
passed_tests: Viewing Distance Calculator (/viewing-distance) loads with data-testid='viewing-distance-calculator'
VDC Mode 1 (Pitch to Distance): Slider changes pixel pitch value, results update dynamically
VDC Mode 2 (Distance to Pitch): Presets work (Stadium=50m), recommended pitch shows correctly (P16)
VDC Content type toggle (Text/Mixed/Video) changes results - Text=2.2m, Video=3.2m optimal for P0.9
VDC Reference table renders all 13 pixel pitches (P0.7 to P20)
VDC FAQ section renders 6 questions with accordion-style UI
VDC Quick Select buttons (P0.9, P1.2, P1.5, P2.5, P3.9, P6, P10) work
Power Consumption Estimator (/power-estimator) loads with data-testid='power-consumption-estimator'
PCE Width/Height sliders change display area in results (tested 10m width = 25m² area)
PCE Pixel pitch buttons (11 total, P0.9 to P16) switch and update power consumption values
PCE Brightness slider affects average power calculation
PCE Electricity rate toggle between UAE(AED)/KSA(SAR)/International($) changes monthly cost
PCE MEP specs calculate correctly: Breaker size (25A-55A), Cable size, Heat BTU/h
PCE Reference table renders all 11 pixel pitches with Max/Avg W/sqm values
PCE GCC Climate Note visible with HVAC/cooling recommendations
Both tools appear in navbar Tools mega-menu under 'SPECIFIER TOOLS' section
Navbar Tools dropdown shows: Viewing Distance with Eye icon, Power Estimator with Zap icon
Navigation from Tools dropdown to both calculator pages works correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Good: Both tools are purely client-side with no backend API calls (except sitemap)
Good: React useMemo optimizes calculations to avoid unnecessary re-renders
Good: All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
Good: Both tools have JSON-LD structured data for SEO (WebApplication schema)
Good: Shared UI components (FAQSection, SectionDivider, SpecPackCTA) from KnowledgeBase
Good: QuickInquiry form appears on scroll (30%) on both pages
Good: Reference tables provide comprehensive technical data for specifiers
Good: WhatsApp CTAs include calculator results in pre-filled message
